description: This file contains JavaScript functions for handling report management in vtiger CRM, including cookie management, report creation, validation, UI interactions, scheduling, and chart display.

methods.name: set_cookie
methods.description: Sets a browser cookie with specified parameters such as name, value, expiration, path, domain, and secure flag.

methods.name: get_cookie
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified cookie by name.

methods.name: delete_cookie
methods.description: Deletes a specified cookie by setting its expiration date to the past.

methods.name: goToURL
methods.description: Redirects the browser to the specified URL.

methods.name: invokeAction
methods.description: Performs navigation based on the action name, redirecting to report creation or schedule report pages.

methods.name: verify_data
methods.description: Validates form data, specifically checking if the folder name is provided.

methods.name: setObjects
methods.description: Initializes references to UI elements related to report columns and movement controls.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds selected items from available list to the selected columns list.

methods.name: addColumnStep1
methods.description: Handles the logic for adding a column from available options to selected columns, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: selectedColumnClick
methods.description: Checks if selected columns are editable, alerting if not.

methods.name: delColumn
methods.description: Removes selected columns from the list.

methods.name: formSelectColumnString
methods.description: Serializes selected columns into a string for form submission.

methods.name: moveUp
methods.description: Moves the selected column up in the list.

methods.name: moveDown
methods.description: Moves the selected column down in the list.

methods.name: disableMove
methods.description: Enables or disables move up/down controls based on selection count.

methods.name: hideTabs
methods.description: Hides or shows certain UI tabs based on report type.

methods.name: showSaveDialog
methods.description: Opens a popup window to save the report.

methods.name: saveAndRunReport
methods.description: Validates columns and submits the report form to generate the report.

methods.name: changeSteps1
methods.description: Handles navigation to the next step in report creation, including validation and scheduling.

methods.name: changeStepsback1
methods.description: Handles navigation to the previous step in report creation.

methods.name: changeSteps
methods.description: Validates report name, checks for duplicates, and proceeds to the next step.

methods.name: changeStepsback
methods.description: Returns to the previous step in report creation.

methods.name: editReport
methods.description: Opens a popup to edit an existing report.

methods.name: CreateReport
methods.description: Opens a popup to create a new report for a selected module.

methods.name: fnPopupWin
methods.description: Opens a new browser window with specified URL and dimensions.

methods.name: re_dateValidate
methods.description: Validates date input fields for correct format and logical correctness.

methods.name: re_patternValidate
methods.description: Validates input against date/time regex patterns.

methods.name: standardFilterDisplay
methods.description: Enables or disables date filter UI elements based on selection.

methods.name: updateRelFieldOptions
methods.description: Updates options for related fields based on selected field type.

methods.name: AddFieldToFilter
methods.description: Adds selected filter values to the filter criteria.

methods.name: fnLoadRepValues
methods.description: Switches UI tabs for report value display.

methods.name: addChartsToHomepage
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to add a chart widget to the homepage dashboard.

methods.name: hidewidgetmessage
methods.description: Fades out the widget success message.

methods.name: getDateFieldGrouping
methods.description: Shows or hides date/time grouping UI based on selected field.

methods.name: vt_getElementsByName
methods.description: Custom implementation to get elements by name, fixing IE bug.

methods.name: setScheduleOptions
methods.description: Adjusts schedule options UI based on selected schedule type.

methods.name: showAddChartPopup
methods.description: Displays the popup for adding a chart to the homepage.

methods.name: placeAtCenterChartPopup
methods.description: Centers the chart popup window on the screen.
